Waffarha negotiates discounted, ready-to-use offers on your behalf with stores and service providers, using group buying: when enough people are interested in an offer, Waffarha negotiates as a single large buyer, letting the seller offer a much bigger discount than they could to an individual. This benefits customers (real discounts, new services to try), sellers (reach new customers, sell more volume), and Waffarha (connects both sides). The offers on Waffarha are not available directly from the seller at the same price.
